records.text: Israel used recordings of Bill Clinton and Monica Lewinsky's phone-sex sessions to pressure Clinton to release Jonathan Pollard from prison.
records.speaker: Tucker Carlson

appearances.snippet: Israel used recordings of Bill Clinton, Monica Lewinsky phone sex sessions as leverage to pressure Clinton into into releasing convicted spy Jonathan Pollard from prison.

verification.notes: Transcript context confirms this was presented as Tucker Carlson recounting an allegation. Public reporting confirms Netanyahu pressed President Clinton to release Jonathan Pollard, but the claim that Israel used Clinton-Lewinsky recordings as leverage is an old, disputed allegation. Contemporary JTA reporting described the tap allegation as contrived and reported denials; no conclusive primary evidence establishes the blackmail mechanism.

records.text: Recounting her Epstein series, Owens alleged Netanyahu blackmailed Bill Clinton with a Monica Lewinsky tape to stop his search for a high-level White House mole called MEGA.
